# Reasoning

The model’s thinking behind a disclosure, summarised as “Thought for 12.4s” and set a step quieter than the answer.

Status: Stable. Semantic versioning applies: nothing breaks without a deprecation first.

The model’s thinking, behind a disclosure. Reasoning is *evidence*, not the answer: useful when the answer looks wrong, noise when it looks right. So it is closed by default and summarised in one line — “Thought for 12.4s” — the fact most readers want from it. Open it and the thought is set in the muted reading voice, a step quieter than the answer it leads to.

## Usage

### When to use

- Keeping reasoning available as evidence, for the moment the answer looks wrong.
- Showing that the model is still thinking, with the working texture and a live clock.

### When not to

- The answer itself. Use [Message](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-message--overview.md).
- The steps an agent took, such as tool calls and handoffs. Use [Agent run](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-agent-run--overview.md).
- Doubt about one claim, which belongs next to the claim. Use [UncertaintyNote](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/ai-confidence--overview.md).

### Do and don’t

- Do: Leave reasoning closed, so the answer is what is read first.
- Don’t: Open reasoning by default above every answer; when the answer is right, it is noise.

### Content

- Pass startedAt and endedAt, or durationMs, so the summary states a time rather than the bare word “Reasoning”.

## API

### `Reasoning` (component)

The model's thinking, behind a disclosure.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` (required) | `string` |  | The reasoning text so far. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `durationMs` | `number` |  | A known duration, when there are no timestamps. |
| `endedAt` | `number \| Date` |  |  |
| `startedAt` | `number \| Date` |  |  |
| `status` | `"streaming" \| "done"` | `done` | `streaming` while the model is still thinking. |

Types: `ReasoningProps`

## Accessibility

### Keyboard

| Key | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves focus to the summary line. |
| Enter or Space | Opens or closes the reasoning. |

### Mola handles

- The summary is a button with `aria-expanded`, named by its own words: “Thinking” or “Thought for 12.4s”.
- Opened while the model thinks, the text is `aria-busy` and says “Reasoning complete.” once when it ends.
- The working texture is hidden from screen readers; the word “Thinking” says the same thing.

### You handle

- Pass `startedAt` and `endedAt`, or `durationMs`, so the summary says how long the model thought.

### Testing status

- Automated, jsdom: each of its 3 stories is rendered and checked with axe on every pull request.
- Automated, browser: every story is checked in Chromium with axe, colour contrast included, in both themes, and for overflow at 390px.
- Keyboard in unit tests: not yet.
- Screen readers: not yet tested by hand.
